version.promotionalText: Playwriting software made for the stage. Your play is a plain file in a folder you choose: no account, nothing to sign in to, and it formats itself as you type.
version.description:
Proscenium is playwriting software, built for plays from the start rather than adapted from the screen.

Type a character's name and press Return: the page formats itself as a stage play, with centered cues, dialogue, stage directions, and act and scene headings. Return goes to the line you most likely want next. When the guess is wrong, Tab changes it. A semicolon on an empty line opens every element, a letter beside each.

EVERYTHING ABOUT THE PLAY, IN ONE PLACE
• A binder beside the script holds the research, the character sheets, the notes, and anything you drop into the play's folder.
• Scenes are cards on a board. Move a card and the play moves with it.
• An outline, a cast list made from whoever actually speaks, and a page count that keeps up as you write.
• Comments in the margin that never print.
• Versions kept as you write, and Changes, which shows on the page what a session or a co-writer altered, to keep or undo.

THE PAGE A THEATER ASKS FOR
• Seven layouts, among them the Dramatists Guild's modern and traditional, Samuel French, and a UK layout. Choose one and the script reflows; your words do not change.
• A format designer, for a festival's own rules.
• Export a print-ready PDF of the whole play, a range of pages, or one actor's sides. Export .docx or .odt, or print.
• Anonymous copy, for a blind submission: your name and contact details stay off the pages, and Proscenium tells you where else your name appears.

BRING A DRAFT WITH YOU
Import .fdx, .docx, .pages, .odt, .rtf, .fountain and plain text. You see how each line was read before the play is made, and your original file is kept, untouched.

YOUR PLAY IS A FILE YOU OWN
Each play is a folder of ordinary files: the script is plain Fountain text and the notes are Markdown, readable in any text editor. Keep them in iCloud Drive, which Proscenium sets up with one click, or in any folder you choose. There is no account, nothing to sign in to, and no machine offering to finish your sentences.

LEARN IT IN A FEW MINUTES
Help & Tutorials has six guided lessons of about three minutes each, which write one practice play together. A card appears beside the thing to click, and Show Me does a step for you.

PRIVACY
Your plays stay on your Mac. Proscenium never sends your writing, a title, a character's name or where your files are. Unless you switch it off in Settings, it sends anonymous counts of which features are used, and reports of crashes, which carry nothing you wrote. Send Feedback sends only what you put in its form.

Proscenium is free and open source, under the GNU Affero General Public License. Its source code is at github.com/proscenium-app/proscenium.
